selected_generation.p: Two entirely INDEPENDENT parallel trainingpasses of one three-token sentence, dynamicmaskresampling. Pass1 row hasTHREE tokens withmiddleemptyoutlinedmask, Pass2THREEtokenswithfirstmask. Eachpass separate token+positionembedding -> itsOWNdrawncopyofa bidirectionalencoder ->itsOWNMLMhead predictingone maskedtoken. Bothencoderboxes have SAMEparameterkeyviaDASHEDline notdataarrows. No central shared representationbox, no any dataflow betweenpasses orstate sharing; parameter equality ONLY. Eachencoder hastinyfull3x3attentiongrid andFFNglyph. ExactlyTHREEinputpositions perpass, ONErecoveredtokenoutput perpass. Richclearbutminimal. NoNSP/segmentembedding. Leave toporbottomnotespace.
selected_generation.full_prompt:
Generate a NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook. External reference images supplied are scientific mechanism references, NOT an edit target; invent your own readable composition and do not copy a reference layout. Style: crisp minimalist flat 2D technical diagram; exact pure white opaque background. ALL individual fills uniform opaque solid color; white and very pale Green #67A583, Blue #7B95C6, Peach #FFC1A6, Rose #C85E62 mixed with white. Neutral wires #4C4D4F. Sparse meaningful planar mechanism glyphs, no decorative card/icon sets. White modules and colored outlines, very restrained pale grouping only if needed. No perspective, 3D, extrusion, shadows, highlights, gradients, paper texture, grain, waves, stripes or uneven blotchy fills. No letters, digits, text, formulas, plus signs, pseudo writing or watermark anywhere; circular operators should be empty for subsequent font typesetting. Reserve clearly sized blank spaces inside operations for 2–5 Chinese-character names, and adjacent to all input/output wires for variables. Avoid huge border enclosing all computation. Aim landscape, readable at textbook figure width.
Absolutely no shadow or semitransparent glow. Use clean straight uniformly dark wires and solid white empty named boxes. Prefer scientific correctness over decoration. Diagram will be read as a computational graph, so no redundant mysterious operators.

history.p: RoBERTa dynamic masking with TWO independent training passes of SAME three-token sentence, not attention between samples. First token row has middle position MASK, second row has first MASK. Both separately add token and position embeddings, run same parameters bidirectional encoder (parameter sharing represented by dashed correspondence, not compute cross sample links), MLM head predicts only respective masked position. Repeat-layer zoom contains post-LN self attention+FFN with residuals. No segment embedding, no next-sentence prediction head. Rich illustrative overview of mask resampling across passes; separate equal samples, shared parameter association, blank token slots and recovered output slots. White modules, pale grouping, independent original composition.
